title: Learning from Totally Unpaired Data via Minimum Conditional Entropy Coupling
abstract: arXiv:2605.16229v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Consider an "unsupervised classification" setting, where the goal is to learn a predictor of the categorical class variable $X$ using the categorical feature variables $Y_1,\ldots,Y_m$, but we can only train the predictor on $m+1$ totally unpaired datasets, where each dataset only consists of unordered samples of one of the variables $X,Y_{1},\ldots,Y_{m}$. Although this problem is highly underdetermined, we demonstrate that, under the assumption that a predictor with small cross entropy loss exists, we can find a good predictor by coupling the marginal distributions of $X,Y_1,\ldots,Y_m$ in a manner that minimizes the conditional entropy $H(X|Y_1,\ldots,Y_m)$. This problem, which we call minimum conditional entropy coupling (MCEC), is a generalization of the widely studied minimum entropy coupling problem (where $m=1$). Although the MCEC problem is NP-hard, we give an algorithm with a time complexity that is polynomial in $N$,

translated_title: 通过最小条件熵耦合从完全非配对数据中学习
translated_abstract: 考虑一个“无监督分类”的设置，其目标是利用类别特征变量 $Y_1,\ldots,Y_m$ 学习类别变量 $X$ 的预测器，但我们只能在 $m+1$ 个完全非配对的数据集上训练该预测器，其中每个数据集仅由变量 $X,Y_1,\ldots,Y_m$ 中某一个变量的无序样本组成。尽管该问题高度欠定，我们证明，在存在具有较小交叉熵损失的预测器的假设下，可以通过以最小化条件熵 $H(X|Y_1,\ldots,Y_m)$ 的方式耦合 $X,Y_1,\ldots,Y_m$ 的边缘分布，从而找到一个好的预测器。我们将这一问题称为最小条件熵耦合（MCEC），它是被广泛研究的最小熵耦合问题（即 $m=1$ 的情形）的推广。尽管 MCEC 问题是 NP-难的，我们给出了一个时间复杂度关于 $N$ 为多项式的算法。
tldr: 提出最小条件熵耦合（MCEC）新方法，仅利用完全非配对的数据集，通过最小化条件熵来耦合边缘分布从而学习类别预测器，并针对该 NP-难问题给出了多项式时间复杂度的算法。
